definitions.explanation: In geometry, a prism — a solid with two identical, parallel polygonal faces connected by rectangular faces. Also used outside math for square-cross-section pillars in buildings.

examples.japanese: {角柱|かくちゅう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}める→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Find the volume of a prism.

examples.japanese: {三角柱|さんかくちゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{底面|ていめん}→底面：22041_teimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A triangular prism has two base faces.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{角柱|かくちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{支|ささ}えられている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: This building is supported by large square pillars.

notes:
Compound of {角|かく} (corner; angle) + {柱|ちゅう} (pillar). The math meaning is the more common one in textbooks; the architectural meaning appears in construction contexts.

COMPOUNDS:
- {三角柱|さんかくちゅう}: triangular prism
- {四角柱|しかくちゅう}: square prism (cuboid)
- {六角柱|ろっかくちゅう}: hexagonal prism

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{円柱|えんちゅう}→円柱：05551_enchuu⟧: cylinder — round cross-section instead of polygonal
- ⟦{角錐|かくすい}→角錐：28896_kakusui⟧: pyramid — comes to a single point instead of a parallel face
- ⟦{柱|はしら}→柱：05009_hashira⟧: pillar (general, everyday word)
